summary: asyncio is a library to write concurrent code using the async/await syntax. Key concepts: Event Loop, Coroutines, Tasks, Futures.
interview_tip: In voice agents and real-time streaming, asyncio allows non-blocking audio packet processing, VAD, and websocket coordination.

summary: Monolith is simple to deploy initially with zero network hop latency. Microservices decouple domains (auth, calls, billing), scale horizontally independently, but require distributed tracing and API gateways.
interview_tip: Highlight CAP theorem and database per service pattern with eventual consistency.

summary: WebRTC establishes peer-to-peer real-time media streams with sub-100ms latency using UDP/SRTP. LiveKit provides an SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) that ingests, mixes, and dispatches media tracks and DataChannels.
interview_tip: Emphasize low-latency Opus audio encoding (20ms packet frames) and reliable data channels for multimodal UI events.
